name: Landing Page Smoke Test
phase: Low-Fidelity Prototyping and Smoke Testing Tactics
hypothesis: We believe cold traffic from [Channel A] will convert on [Core Value Proposition]. We will verify this by driving 1,000 qualified visitors to a standalone landing page, and consider it validated if the conversion rate (email capture or pricing tier selection) meets or exceeds 5.0% with a target Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) below $15.00.
schematic: Read at step 3 of the 3-step strip

plan.label: Preparation
plan.text: Build one page with headline, value pillars, proof and a single call to action; instrument every button.

plan.label: Execution
plan.text: Buy targeted search or social traffic from the ideal customer profile and send it to the page.

plan.label: Data collection
plan.text: Track unique visitors, bounce, dwell time and conversion on the primary call to action.

planFull.label: Preparation
planFull.text: Build a high-converting, single-page website featuring a clear headline, value pillars, social proof, and a prominent primary Call-to-Action (CTA). Configure analytics and tracking events on every button.

planFull.label: Execution
planFull.text: Launch targeted paid search or social ad campaigns driving traffic from the target ICP to the landing page.

planFull.label: Data collection
planFull.text: Track total unique visitors, bounce rate, dwell time, and conversion percentage on the primary CTA.

warning.label: Vanity Email Opt-Ins
warning.text: Visitors hand over burner emails for a free download with no intention of paying.

warningFull: Visitors will casually provide secondary or burner email addresses to download free materials or peek at a website, with no real intention of purchasing paid software.
